title: 一天从一碗面开始
logline: 清晨面馆后厨，老板揉面、煮面后将第一碗热面端给窗边首位客人，诠释日常仪式感。

shots.narrationZh: 清晨揉面，是头一份踏实
shots.narrationEn: The early morning kneading is the first touch of solid comfort.
shots.visual: Close-up of a noodle shop owner's hands rhythmically kneading pale dough on a floured wooden board in the dim back kitchen at dawn, with a simmering broth pot visible in the background.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪温暖踏实，语速平缓适中，重音落在「头一份」，气息沉稳带满足感

shots.narrationZh: 沸水煮面，热气升起来的时候
shots.narrationEn: When the water boils and noodles cook, steam rises up.
shots.visual: Medium shot of fresh noodles being dropped into a rolling pot of boiling broth, thick steam billowing up to fill the upper half of the vertical frame.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪轻快带期待，语速稍缓，重音落在「热气升起来」，气息轻柔带暖意

shots.narrationZh: 一天，就从这碗面开始了
shots.narrationEn: The whole day starts with this bowl of noodles.
shots.visual: Close-up of the owner placing a steaming bowl of topped noodles on the windowsill counter in front of the first seated customer, who smiles and nods in greeting.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪温暖笃定，语速放缓，重音落在「这碗面」，气息平稳带笑意，收尾利落
